name: VGGFace2
description: VGGFace2 is a face recognition dataset containing about 9,000 identities and 3.3 million images. Access is gated under Oxford research-only terms; this record is loader-only and does not vendor dataset data.
citation: Cao, Q., Shen, L., Xie, W., Parkhi, O. M., & Zisserman, A. (2018). VGGFace2: A dataset for recognising faces across pose and age. 13th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face & Gesture Recognition (FG 2018).
